summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K on 5 November 2026 reminding holders that trading in its DKK 1.00 shares (ISIN DK0061412772) was suspended on the Oslo Stock Exchange from the open, and that trading in its NYSE-listed ADSs (one ADS representing four shares) is expected to suspend before market open, with NYSE delisting effective in roughly 10 days. The step follows the voluntary share-for-share offer by Cadeler plc (one USD 1.00 share per Cadeler share) tied to the group's Denmark-to-UK redomiciliation; Cadeler plc also intends a Danish Companies Act cash squeeze-out starting on or about 9 November 2026, with a four-week transfer period, and an EGM to approve delisting. Watch the squeeze-out notice timing and price, residual ownership, Oslo delisting approval, and any arbitrage spread.
